research_basis.authoring_method: Original synthesis using the user brief and the THE DMI implementation reference as the structural benchmark.
research_basis.licence_handling: Original implementation content informed by Jisc AI maturity structure. Scenarios and practitioner language are independently written to avoid reproducing Jisc wording.

objects.focus_statement: At the Emerging level, the institution recognises and experiments whether AI is reactive, coordinated, or strategically embedded through visible structures, routines, and decisions rather than isolated examples.
observable_behaviours: There is visible progress in ai strategy & leadership, but it remains uneven across units and often depends on local champions.
Institutional ownership exists in principle, yet routines, incentives, or evidence are not consistent enough to travel well.
Leaders can point to examples, though the system would still be vulnerable if key people or projects disappeared.

common_misconceptions.statement: treating a single principles statement as a full strategy
assuming enthusiasm from one executive means institution-wide leadership
Overstates competence because the task felt familiar.

institution_type.calibration_rule: Judge what is observable within the setting, while keeping expectations proportionate to role and remit.
